capabilities: Render a Markdown note as a resume with live preview beside the editor
Choose among three templates (Salt, Pepper, Plumeria) and set an accent color
Export a one-page PDF with automatic Name_Company_yyyy-mm-dd file naming
Report page-fill status and flag resumes that exceed one page
Create an example resume to start from
disambiguation: Not a job-application tracker; it only renders a resume note into a one-page PDF.
extras: Export is limited to one page: content beyond one page raises an error, and a minimum page fill is enforced with an adjustable warning. The README states the plugin works offline with no account, AI, or upload required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Markdown note into a designed, exportable resume PDF.
summary: Resume builder that renders a Markdown note into a polished one-page PDF, with template choices and live preview inside Obsidian.
